children: has reached a deal with Ireland-based DCC Energy for the proposed ​sale of its network of fuel retail stations and related ‌transport fuel services in France, Reuters reported Friday, without providing financial details.

A deal has not been finalized, ​although completion is expected in Q2 2027, subject ​to consultation with employee representatives, according to the report, which also said the transaction would include ~70 sites, eight LNG installations, and the transfer of 35 employees.
DCC Energy reportedly would operate the stations under a long-term Shell
brand license, but Shell's core fuel supply operations would be excluded, ​meaning the ⁠buyer would source its fuel independently.
DCC Energy serves millions of customers across the industrial and public sectors and delivers off-grid energy solutions, led by liquid gas, the company's website ​said.

title: Shell to sell French fuel stations to DCC Energy - Reuters
